shots.name: 05-speak-write-after-write-result
steps: (async()=>{await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));const w=()=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150));const btn=(re)=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.btn')].find(b=>!b.hidden&&re.test(b.textContent));for(let k=0;k<5;k++){const inp=document.querySelector('.type-in');if(inp){inp.value=k?'x':document.querySelector('.say-ko')?'':'festival';inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input'));await w();}while(document.querySelector('.tile')){document.querySelector('.tile').click();await w();}while(document.querySelector('.card-pool .wcard')&&btn(/확인하기/).disabled){document.querySelector('.card-pool .wcard').click();await w();}btn(/확인하기/).click();await w();btn(/다음 문제|결과 보기/).click();await w();}return document.querySelector('.score').textContent+' / levels '+JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('er5.attempts')).filter(a=>a.skill==='write').map(a=>a.level).join(',')})()
